Task Description:
Your task is to create a file /app/src/program.cbl in which there will be a new COBOL program in fixed format, 
which will be run from the /app/src directory and should be compiled and executed using GnuCOBOL 3.

The program will run from /app/src directory and must compile with GnuCOBOL 3. File /app/src/INPUT.DAT already exist.
  Processes mortgage applications. Checks terms and generates a payment schedule. The program reads the existing file at /app/src/INPUT.DAT.
  ID - X(10) NAME - X(30) LOAN-AMOUNT - 9(10) PROPERTY-VALUE - 9(10) DOWN-PAYMENT - 9(10) TERM - 9(2) RATE - 9(3)V9(2) separated by the symbol ';'.
  Calculates the minimum down payment (15% of the property value). If the client's down payment is less, the application is rejected.
  For approved applications, the monthly payment is calculated using the annuity nominal formula and a full payment schedule is generated.
  The results are written to the file at /app/data/OUTPUT.DAT: ID - X(10) STATUS - X(5) (REASON - X(50) in case of refusal)
    For rejected applications: ID and reason for rejection.
    For approved applications: ID and  «APPRO\n» and detailed payment schedule:
    MON-NUMBER - 9(3) PAYMENT-AMOUNT, INTEREST-PART, PRINCIPAL-PART - 9(8).99 REMAINING-BALANCE - 9(10).99.(without header).
    - CALCULATIONS: 
        MIN_DOWN = PROP_VALUE * 0.15
        MONTHLY_RATE = INTEREST_RATE / 1200
        MONTHLY_PAYMENT = LOAN_AMOUNT * monthly_rate / (1 - (1 + monthly_rate)**(-term_months))
        Use ROUNDED for all financial computations.

    A correctly constructed payment schedule in the file output. Example output file:
     «TEST000001DENY INSUFFICIENT FUNDS FOR DOWN PAYMENT

       PROGRAM-ID. PROGRAM.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT IN-FILE ASSIGN TO "/app/src/INPUT.DAT"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT OUT-FILE ASSIGN TO "/app/data/OUTPUT.DAT"

       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD IN-FILE.
       01 IN-REC PIC X(200).
       FD OUT-FILE.
       01 OUT-REC PIC X(200).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-EOF            PIC X VALUE "N".
          88 EOF            VALUE "Y".
          88 NOT-EOF        VALUE "N".
       01 WS-DELIM          PIC X VALUE ";".
       01 WS-ID             PIC X(10).
       01 WS-NAME           PIC X(30).
       01 WS-LOAN-AMOUNT    PIC 9(10)V9(2).
       01 WS-PROP-VALUE     PIC 9(10)V9(2).
       01 WS-DOWN-PAY       PIC 9(10)V9(2).
       01 WS-TERM           PIC 9(2).
       01 WS-RATE           PIC 9(3)V9(2).
       01 WS-MIN-DOWN       PIC 9(10)V9(2).
       01 WS-MONTHLY-RATE   PIC S9(5)V9(5).
       01 WS-MONTHLY-PAY    PIC 9(10)V9(2).
       01 WS-BALANCE        PIC 9(10)V9(2).
       01 WS-INTEREST       PIC 9(10)V9(2).
       01 WS-PRINCIPAL      PIC 9(10)V9(2).
       01 WS-MONTH-NO       PIC 9(3).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           OPEN INPUT IN-FILE
                OUTPUT OUT-FILE.
           PERFORM UNTIL EOF
               READ IN-FILE AT END SET EOF TO TRUE
               NOT AT END
                   MOVE IN-REC TO OUT-REC
                   UNSTRING OUT-REC DELIMITED BY WS-DELIM
                     INTO WS-ID, WS-NAME, WS-LOAN-AMOUNT,
                          WS-PROP-VALUE, WS-DOWN-PAY,
                          WS-TERM, WS-RATE
                   PERFORM PROCESS-RECORD
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM.
           CLOSE IN-FILE OUT-FILE.
           STOP RUN.
       PROCESS-RECORD.
           COMPUTE WS-MIN-DOWN = WS-PROP-VALUE * 0.15 ROUNDED.
           IF WS-DOWN-PAY < WS-MIN-DOWN
               STRING WS-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE
                      " DENY INSUFFICIENT FUNDS FOR DOWN PAYMENT"
                      INTO OUT-REC
               WRITE OUT-REC
           ELSE
               STRING WS-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE " APPRO" INTO OUT-REC
               WRITE OUT-REC
               MOVE WS-LOAN-AMOUNT TO WS-BALANCE
               COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-RATE = WS-RATE / 1200 ROUNDED
               COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-PAY = WS-LOAN-AMOUNT * WS-MONTHLY-RATE /
                     (1 - (1 + WS-MONTHLY-RATE) ** (-WS-TERM)) ROUNDED
               PERFORM VARYING WS-MONTH-NO FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-MONTH-NO > WS-TERM
                   COMPUTE WS-INTEREST = WS-BALANCE * WS-MONTHLY-RATE ROUNDED
                   COMPUTE WS-PRINCIPAL = WS-MONTHLY-PAY - WS-INTEREST ROUNDED
                   COMPUTE WS-BALANCE = WS-BALANCE - WS-PRINCIPAL ROUNDED
                   STRING WS-MONTH-NO DELIMITED BY SIZE " "
                          WS-MONTHLY-PAY DELIMITED BY SIZE " "
                          WS-INTEREST DELIMITED BY SIZE " "
                          WS-PRINCIPAL DELIMITED BY SIZE " "
                          WS-BALANCE DELIMITED BY SIZE
                          INTO OUT-REC
                   WRITE OUT-REC
               END-PERFORM
           END-IF.
EOF
",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "cobc -x /app/src/program.cbl -o /app/src/program
",
      "duration": 2.0
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "/app/src/program
",
      "duration": 1.0
    }
  ],
  "task_complete": true
}
